evidence: The Ga2O3-TiO2 films were deposited on Si (001) substrate at 200◦C and under a pressure of 1.0 Torr using PEALD with an alternating supply of [(CH3)2GaNH2]3,O2 plasma, Ti(N(CH3)2)4 and O2 plasma. One deposition cycle consists of four pulses: [(CH3)2GaNH2]3 or Ti(N(CH3)2)4 vapor pulse with 100 sccm Ar carrier gas for 0.1s, Ar purge gas pulse for 2s, O2 plasma gas pulse for 1s, and Ar purge gas pulse for 0.4s.
